note: Buyer award authorship (BEC defense). Verify the directory against root_public_key_hex, resolve the award sig's kid to a directory entry whose org_id equals buyer.org_id, then verify the ML-DSA-87 signature over the canonical award body {spec, traveler_id, traveler_hash, award (minus its own sig), ship_to}. A forged award, an altered ship_to, a bumped revision, or a non-buyer signer all fail. Evaluate at at_ms (inside the windows).
